import Mathlib

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def sieve_of_eratosthenes_precond (n : Nat) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  n ≤ 100_000
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
/-- `getD` on an in-bounds index. -/
theorem gdlt (a : Array Bool) (k : Nat) (h : k < a.size) : a.getD k false = a[k] := by
  first
    | exact Array.getD_eq_getElem h
    | exact Array.getD_eq_get h
    | simp [Array.getD, h]
    | simp [Array.getD, dif_pos h]

/-- `getD` on an out-of-bounds index. -/
theorem gdge (a : Array Bool) (k : Nat) (h : a.size ≤ k) : a.getD k false = false := by
  first
    | exact Array.getD_eq_default _ _ h
    | simp [Array.getD, Nat.not_lt.mpr h]
    | simp [Array.getD, dif_neg (Nat.not_lt.mpr h)]

theorem getD_set_ne (a : Array Bool) (j k : Nat) (h : j < a.size) (hjk : j ≠ k) :
    (a.set j false h).getD k false = a.getD k false := by
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge k a.size with hk | hk
  · rw [gdlt _ _ (by rw [Array.size_set]; exact hk), gdlt _ _ hk]
    simp [Array.getElem_set, hjk]
  · rw [gdge _ _ (by rw [Array.size_set]; exact hk), gdge _ _ hk]

/-- The initial array: all `true`, except indices `0` and `1`. -/
def initArr (n : Nat) : Array Bool := Array.ofFn (fun i : Fin n => decide (1 < i.val))

theorem initArr_size (n : Nat) : (initArr n).size = n := by simp [initArr]

theorem initArr_get (n k : Nat) (h : k < n) : (initArr n).getD k false = decide (1 < k) := by
  rw [gdlt _ _ (by rw [initArr_size]; exact h)]
  simp [initArr]

/-- Inner loop: mark `j, j+i, j+2i, ...` as `false`, with `f` steps of fuel. -/
def markAux (i : Nat) (a : Array Bool) (j : Nat) : Nat → Array Bool
  | 0 => a
  | f + 1 => if h : j < a.size then markAux i (a.set j false h) (j + i) f else a

/-- Mark every multiple of `i` starting from `j` as `false`. -/
def mark (i : Nat) (a : Array Bool) (j : Nat) : Array Bool := markAux i a j a.size

theorem markAux_size (i : Nat) : ∀ (f : Nat) (a : Array Bool) (j : Nat),
    (markAux i a j f).size = a.size := by
  intro f
  induction f with
  | zero => intro a j; simp only [markAux]
  | succ f ih =>
    intro a j
    simp only [markAux]
    split
    · next h => rw [ih]; rw [Array.size_set]
    · next h => rfl

theorem markAux_getD_of_ne (i : Nat) : ∀ (f : Nat) (a : Array Bool) (j k : Nat),
    (∀ t, j + t * i ≠ k) → (markAux i a j f).getD k false = a.getD k false := by
  intro f
  induction f with
  | zero => intro a j k _; simp only [markAux]
  | succ f ih =>
    intro a j k hne
    simp only [markAux]
    split
    · next h =>
      have hstep : ∀ t, (j + i) + t * i ≠ k := by
        intro t
        have h2 := hne (t + 1)
        rw [Nat.succ_mul] at h2
        omega
      rw [ih (a.set j false h) (j + i) k hstep]
      have hjk : j ≠ k := by have := hne 0; simpa using this
      exact getD_set_ne a j k h hjk
    · next h => rfl

theorem markAux_marked (i : Nat) (hi : 0 < i) : ∀ (f : Nat) (a : Array Bool) (j : Nat),
    a.size ≤ f + j → ∀ t : Nat, (markAux i a j f).getD (j + t * i) false = false := by
  intro f
  induction f with
  | zero =>
    intro a j hf t
    simp only [markAux]
    exact gdge _ _ (by omega)
  | succ f ih =>
    intro a j hf t
    simp only [markAux]
    split
    · next h =>
      cases t with
      | zero =>
        simp only [Nat.zero_mul, Nat.add_zero]
        rw [markAux_getD_of_ne i f (a.set j false h) (j + i) j (by intro t; omega)]
        rw [gdlt _ _ (by rw [Array.size_set]; exact h)]
        simp
      | succ t =>
        have he : j + (t + 1) * i = (j + i) + t * i := by rw [Nat.succ_mul]; omega
        rw [he]
        exact ih (a.set j false h) (j + i) (by rw [Array.size_set]; omega) t
    · next h =>
      exact gdge _ _ (by omega)

theorem mark_size (i : Nat) (a : Array Bool) (j : Nat) : (mark i a j).size = a.size :=
  markAux_size i _ _ _

theorem mark_ne (i : Nat) (a : Array Bool) (j k : Nat) (h : ∀ t, j + t * i ≠ k) :
    (mark i a j).getD k false = a.getD k false :=
  markAux_getD_of_ne i _ _ _ _ h

theorem mark_marked (i : Nat) (hi : 0 < i) (a : Array Bool) (j t : Nat) :
    (mark i a j).getD (j + t * i) false = false :=
  markAux_marked i hi _ _ _ (by omega) t

/-- Outer loop: for `i` from the given value while `i * i < n`, sieve multiples of `i`. -/
def sieveLoop (n : Nat) (a : Array Bool) (i : Nat) : Nat → Array Bool
  | 0 => a
  | f + 1 =>
    if i * i < n then
      sieveLoop n (if a.getD i false then mark i a (i * i) else a) (i + 1) f
    else a

/-- `k` has no divisor `d` with `1 < d < i` and `d < k`. -/
@[reducible]
def NoSmallFac (k i : Nat) : Prop := 1 < k ∧ ∀ d, 1 < d → d < i → d < k → ¬ (d ∣ k)

/-- Loop invariant of the outer loop. -/
@[reducible]
def SieveInv (n : Nat) (a : Array Bool) (i : Nat) : Prop :=
  a.size = n ∧ ∀ k, k < n → (a.getD k false = true ↔ NoSmallFac k i)
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definitions
def sieve_of_eratosthenes (n : Nat) (h_precond : sieve_of_eratosthenes_precond n) : Array Bool :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  sieveLoop n (initArr n) 2 n
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def sieve_of_eratosthenes_postcond (n : Nat) (result : Array Bool) (h_precond : sieve_of_eratosthenes_precond n) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  result.size = n ∧
  ∀ i : Nat, i < n →
    ((result.getD i false = true) ↔
      (i > 1 ∧ ∀ d : Nat, (1 < d ∧ d < i) → i % d ≠ 0))
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
theorem sieve_step (n : Nat) (a : Array Bool) (i : Nat) (hi : 2 ≤ i)
    (hin : i * i < n) (h : SieveInv n a i) :
    SieveInv n (if a.getD i false then mark i a (i * i) else a) (i + 1) := by
  have hii : 2 * i ≤ i * i := Nat.mul_le_mul hi (le_refl i)
  have hiN : i < n := by omega
  split
  · next c =>
    refine ⟨by rw [mark_size]; exact h.1, ?_⟩
    intro k hk
    by_cases hex : ∃ t, i * i + t * i = k
    · obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hex
      rw [← ht, mark_marked i (by omega)]
      simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, false_iff]
      intro hp
      exact hp.2 i (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) ⟨i + t, by ring⟩
    · rw [mark_ne i a (i * i) k (fun t he => hex ⟨t, he⟩), h.2 k hk]
      constructor
      · intro hp
        obtain ⟨hk1, hd⟩ := hp
        refine ⟨hk1, ?_⟩
        intro d hd1 hd2 hd3 hdvd
        rcases Nat.lt_or_ge d i with hlt | hge
        · exact hd d hd1 hlt hd3 hdvd
        · have hdi : d = i := by omega
          rw [hdi] at hdvd hd3
          obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hdvd
          have hm2 : 2 ≤ m := by
            by_contra hc
            have hle : i * m ≤ i * 1 := Nat.mul_le_mul (le_refl i) (by omega)
            simp at hle
            omega
          have hmi : m < i := by
            by_contra hc
            refine hex ⟨m - i, ?_⟩
            have h1 : i * i ≤ m * i := Nat.mul_le_mul (by omega) (le_refl i)
            have h2 : i * m = m * i := Nat.mul_comm i m
            rw [Nat.sub_mul]
            omega
          have hmk : m < k := by
            have h3 : 2 * m ≤ i * m := Nat.mul_le_mul hi (le_refl m)
            omega
          exact hd m (by omega) hmi hmk ⟨i, by rw [hm]; ring⟩
      · intro hp
        obtain ⟨hk1, hd⟩ := hp
        exact ⟨hk1, fun d hd1 hd2 hd3 => hd d hd1 (by omega) hd3⟩
  · next c =>
    refine ⟨h.1, ?_⟩
    intro k hk
    rw [h.2 k hk]
    have hnp : ¬ NoSmallFac i i := by
      intro hp
      exact c ((h.2 i hiN).mpr hp)
    have hfac : ∃ d, 1 < d ∧ d < i ∧ d ∣ i := by
      simp only [NoSmallFac, not_and] at hnp
      push_neg at hnp
      obtain ⟨d, hd1, hd2, hd3, hd4⟩ := hnp (by omega)
      exact ⟨d, hd1, hd2, hd4⟩
    constructor
    · intro hp
      obtain ⟨hk1, hd⟩ := hp
      refine ⟨hk1, ?_⟩
      intro d hd1 hd2 hd3 hdvd
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge d i with hlt | hge
      · exact hd d hd1 hlt hd3 hdvd
      · have hdi : d = i := by omega
        rw [hdi] at hdvd hd3
        obtain ⟨e, he1, he2, he3⟩ := hfac
        exact hd e he1 he2 (by omega) (he3.trans hdvd)
    · intro hp
      obtain ⟨hk1, hd⟩ := hp
      exact ⟨hk1, fun d hd1 hd2 hd3 => hd d hd1 (by omega) hd3⟩

theorem sieve_final (n : Nat) (a : Array Bool) (i : Nat) (hi : 2 ≤ i)
    (hn : n ≤ i * i) (h : SieveInv n a i) :
    a.size = n ∧ ∀ k, k < n → (a.getD k false = true ↔ Nat.Prime k) := by
  refine ⟨h.1, ?_⟩
  intro k hk
  rw [h.2 k hk]
  constructor
  · intro hp
    obtain ⟨hk1, hd⟩ := hp
    by_contra hnp
    have hk1' : k ≠ 1 := by omega
    have hprime := Nat.minFac_prime hk1'
    have hdvd := Nat.minFac_dvd k
    have hp2 : 2 ≤ k.minFac := hprime.two_le
    have hsq : k.minFac * k.minFac ≤ k := by
      first
        | (have hs := Nat.minFac_sq_le_self (show 0 < k by omega) hnp
           calc k.minFac * k.minFac = k.minFac ^ 2 := by ring
             _ ≤ k := hs)
        | (have h1 := Nat.minFac_le_div (show 0 < k by omega) hnp
           exact (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le (Nat.minFac_pos k)).mp h1)
    have hlt : k.minFac < i := by
      by_contra hc
      have hge : i ≤ k.minFac := by omega
      have : i * i ≤ k.minFac * k.minFac := Nat.mul_le_mul hge hge
      omega
    have hltk : k.minFac < k := by
      have : 2 * k.minFac ≤ k.minFac * k.minFac := Nat.mul_le_mul hp2 (le_refl _)
      omega
    exact hd k.minFac (by omega) hlt hltk hdvd
  · intro hp
    refine ⟨hp.two_le, ?_⟩
    intro d hd1 hd2 hd3 hdvd
    rcases hp.eq_one_or_self_of_dvd d hdvd with h1 | h1 <;> omega

theorem sieve_loop_spec : ∀ (f n : Nat) (a : Array Bool) (i : Nat), 2 ≤ i →
    n ≤ f + i * i → SieveInv n a i →
    (sieveLoop n a i f).size = n ∧
      ∀ k, k < n → ((sieveLoop n a i f).getD k false = true ↔ Nat.Prime k) := by
  intro f
  induction f with
  | zero =>
    intro n a i hi hn h
    simp only [sieveLoop]
    exact sieve_final n a i hi (by omega) h
  | succ f ih =>
    intro n a i hi hn h
    simp only [sieveLoop]
    split
    · next hlt =>
      refine ih n _ (i + 1) (by omega) ?_ (sieve_step n a i hi hlt h)
      have he : (i + 1) * (i + 1) = i * i + 2 * i + 1 := by ring
      omega
    · next hge =>
      exact sieve_final n a i hi (by omega) h
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem sieve_of_eratosthenes_postcond_satisfied (n : Nat) (h_precond : sieve_of_eratosthenes_precond n) :
    sieve_of_eratosthenes_postcond n (sieve_of_eratosthenes n h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  unfold sieve_of_eratosthenes_postcond sieve_of_eratosthenes
  have h0 : SieveInv n (initArr n) 2 := by
    refine ⟨initArr_size n, ?_⟩
    intro k hk
    rw [initArr_get n k hk]
    simp only [decide_eq_true_eq]
    constructor
    · intro hd
      exact ⟨hd, fun d hd1 hd2 hd3 hdvd => by omega⟩
    · intro hh
      exact hh.1
  have hres := sieve_loop_spec n n (initArr n) 2 (le_refl 2) (by omega) h0
  refine ⟨hres.1, ?_⟩
  intro k hk
  rw [hres.2 k hk]
  constructor
  · intro hp
    refine ⟨hp.two_le, ?_⟩
    intro d hd hmod
    obtain ⟨hd1, hd2⟩ := hd
    have hdvd : d ∣ k := Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero hmod
    rcases hp.eq_one_or_self_of_dvd d hdvd with h1 | h1 <;> omega
  · intro hp
    obtain ⟨hk1, hmod⟩ := hp
    rw [Nat.prime_def_lt']
    refine ⟨by omega, ?_⟩
    intro m hm2 hmk hdvd
    refine hmod m ⟨by omega, hmk⟩ ?_
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hdvd
    rw [hc]
    exact Nat.mul_mod_right m c
  -- !benchmark @end proof

**LEAN VERIFIED** — only linter warnings remain (unused fallback branches in `first | ... | ...` combinators, unused teacher-supplied binders).

What was implemented, all inside the four markers:

**auxcode**
- `initArr n` — array of size `n`, `true` everywhere except indices 0 and 1.
- `markAux i a j f` / `mark i a j` — the inner loop: sets `a[j], a[j+i], a[j+2i], …` to `false` while in bounds (fuel-bounded structural recursion, fuel `= a.size`, which is provably sufficient for stride `i ≥ 1`).
- `sieveLoop n a i f` — the outer loop: while `i*i < n`, if `a[i]` is still `true`, mark multiples of `i` starting at `i*i`; then `i+1`.
- `NoSmallFac k i := 1 < k ∧ ∀ d, 1 < d → d < i → d < k → ¬ d ∣ k` and the loop invariant `SieveInv n a i`.
- Access lemmas: `gdlt`/`gdge` (in/out of bounds `getD`), `getD_set_ne`; stride lemmas `mark_size`, `mark_ne` (indices *not* of the form `i*i + t*i` are untouched) and `mark_marked` (every `i*i + t*i` ends up `false`).

**code** — `sieveLoop n (initArr n) 2 n`.

**lemma**
- `sieve_step`: the invariant is preserved by one outer iteration. This is where the two challenge obligations land: every marked index is `i*i + t*i`, hence a multiple of `i`; and for the `i*i` optimization, any multiple `k = i*m < i*i` has `2 ≤ m < i` with `m ∣ k` and `m < k`, so it was already eliminated — likewise when `i` itself is composite, a factor `d < i` of `i` divides `k`.
- `sieve_final`: once `n ≤ i*i`, the invariant implies `a[k] = true ↔ Nat.Prime k`, via `Nat.minFac_sq_le_self` (a composite `k < i*i` has `minFac k * minFac k ≤ k < i*i`, so `minFac k < i`).
- `sieve_loop_spec`: induction on fuel, with `n ≤ f + i*i` guaranteeing the loop runs to completion.

**proof** — establishes the initial invariant at `i = 2`, applies `sieve_loop_spec` (fuel `n`, since `n ≤ n + 4`), then converts `Nat.Prime k` to the postcondition's trial-division form using `Nat.prime_def_lt'` and `Nat.mul_mod_right`.

No `sorry`, `admit`, axioms, `decide` on the target property, `Nat.find`, `Classical.choose`, sorting, or enumeration; the teacher's `sorry`-free non-editable regions are untouched.
